This violates the "Required result" clause ("remove head 5") for all three tensors (`c_attn.weight`, `c_attn.bias`, `c_proj.weight`). Although the resulting shapes ([768,2112], [2112], [704,768]) match and pass the required checks, the kept column/row ranges will differ from the specified `0..319, 384..767, ...` pattern once past the point where head 5 vs head 6 diverges, so the values will not be bit-exact with the hidden reference despite matching shapes.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
